_meta.description: Canonical BeTiSe full-dataset configuration. Base/feature-type compositions are stored as templates; categorical feature variants are defined once in feature_variants and are expanded at runtime. Continuous parameters remain sampled from params.json.
notes: Seasonality and volatility remain base-family components.
Categorical/structural feature parameters are enumerated through feature_variants.
Continuous numeric parameters remain sampled from params.json.
Multiple-event variants omit location because the generator places events across the safe region.
Multiple mean/variance shift directions are sampled randomly per break; direction is not a dataset variant axis.
Trend shift inherits the initial linear-trend direction; change_type is enumerated separately.
Multiple collective anomalies use a uniform shape strategy or a mixed strategy instead of explicitly enumerating every ordered per-event shape sequence.
Multiple point anomalies currently use the generator's length-dependent automatic count.
pure_sarma, pure_sarima, and seasonal_unit_root_fourier remain excluded from canonical compositions.
